notes.title: Update 2.0.2.0: Fixes and Enhancements
notes.notes:
Various improvements:
[list]
[*] pngtuber plus migration progress
[*] tuned llm parameters for TTSpet
[*] fixed GIF images not working after restart
[*] make linux build "work" -> this is only available on itch.io as it isn't stable enough to be release ready on steam (same goes for mac) -> working on this though
[*] resize T.I.T.S. items by 50% and resize based on render size
[*] fix: better logs, should now also log startup crashes to help with debugging especially on non windows
[/list]

notes.title: New update coming: sprite support
notes.notes:
I'm working on a new update which will introduce an alternative system for pngs, a sprite based one like pngtuber plus has.

I'm trying not to break the current functionality to much, the goal is to have two different modes:
1. simple png setup
2. sprite based setup


Currently looking for any beta testers, feel free to join the discord if you want to participate
[url=https://discord.com/invite/4cMVGAhukH]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.5: StreamDeck Integration
notes.notes:
This update integrates a way to control PNGify.me over streamdeck.
All you need to do is update to the recent version and install the streamdeck plugin.

You can download the plugin here:
https://github.com/AWAS666/Pngify.me/releases/download/1.0.0.5/me.pngify.streamdeck.streamDeckPlugin


It will also be submitted to their marketplace, but that will take some time.

Other changes:

[list]
[*] streamdeck integration
[*] fixed an error that caused errors to crash the app (how ironic...)
[*] adjusted credits
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.4: Fixed number input
notes.notes:
Number input was a tad bit broken, especially in certain regions where "," and "." is mixed from mine.
Fixed now and there are two buttons to also change it.
